cp.scenario.authorized.label: Expected success
cp.scenario.authorized.desc: A caller whose application hash IS registered on the App, reading a Safe it may access → the credential is returned.
cp.scenario.authorized.ev1.lead: Authenticated by application hash, not a key.
cp.scenario.authorized.ev1.body: The Credential Provider measured the calling jar's hash (plus OS user and path) and matched it to a registered Application — no client certificate, no stored password.
cp.scenario.authorized.ev2.lead: The full secret never left the host.
cp.scenario.authorized.ev2.body: The caller hashed the credential on the host; only a 6-char preview, its length, and SHA-256 crossed the bridge into the cluster.
cp.scenario.authorized.ev3.body: The App is provisioned for PIN-SEC-DEMO only; every other Safe is denied at the authorization layer.
cp.trace.measure: Credential Provider measures the calling application (hash + path)
cp.trace.checkOsUser: checks OS user ({osUser}) and executable path
cp.trace.authzQuery: Vault: is Application '{appId}' authorized for Safe {safe}?
